title: Mochizuki Honami — Swimming Lessons in the Sea〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, this rice is coming along nicely. All that's left is to get the curry ready...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've helped my mom cook before, but never really made anything before myself. I hope it turns out okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine♪
I'm in the same boat as you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: More importantly, we have Chef Hona in our group. Whatever we make is guaranteed to be delicious!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's a pretty standard curry recipe too, so I'm sure we won't have much trouble with it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right, okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm back☆
I was first in line for ingredients!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu.
Let's start prepping the vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, my eyes...!
This always happens when I chop onions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really? My eyes are fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! How?!
Are my onions stronger or something?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, be careful!
You'll hurt yourself if you don't look where you're chopping.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I promise to be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I've heard that it helps to hold your breath as you chop down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that really work?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think so. Apparently, it has to do with the sulfenic acid that's in onions...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As you chop, they emit this substance that clings to your eyes and nose. Your body reacts by trying to wash it away, for example, using tears...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I never knew that! So I should just try to not breathe in this stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane, do you need any help with the potatoes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay! I'm actually just about done cutting them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that was fast! And based on how quickly you peeled them, you must be quite the prep cook.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It must be because of how I help my mom as much as I can whenever she cooks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, we still have to cut the carrots.
The recipe said quarter slices, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane! Wanna try cutting them into some cuter shapes instead?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Cuter shapes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Like stars or hearts!
They can be little ornaments for our curry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
I wanna try! I wanna try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't have time to cut them all into stars or hearts, but we can set some aside just for that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Honami, your stars and hearts are cut too neatly!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yours look cute too, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They do? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, Emu, how are yours coming along?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ My stars and hearts look like... This!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I couldn't cut them as neatly as Honami, but I made this star look really big and strong! See?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's so cool!
I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, how do mine look?
I kinda had trouble rounding the edges of my hearts and had to try a few times to sort of get it right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry, Saki, they look very cute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The way your stars are slanted makes it look like they'll twinkle as they shoot through the sky!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You really always know exactly what to say, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's set these aside for now and start prepping the meat...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, we're out of ingredients...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Th-There's no meat...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Could I have dropped them somewhere on my way back?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: E-Emu, please try to calm down. The roux's all done, so it should be fine even without any meat.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But out curry would feel so sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go see if I did drop them somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, are you looking for this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A teacher said that they forgot to give one of the groups their packet of meat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My group wasn't given any either and got some from them just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So we didn't have any to begin with...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness...!
You saved us, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna go get some right now! Here comes the Emu Super Express!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I think some other groups are still in the dark, so I'll go tell them what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you so much, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We owe you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm baaack!
We're all set now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu.
Let's get back to cooking, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, it's ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, our decoration carrots are ready too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm done plating the rice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great. I'll pour the curry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'll throw on the stars and hearts!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the one on top is the one I made! Who wants my delicious heart♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These stars and hearts are so cute! Hehe. I think I'll take a photo to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, would it be alright if I take photos of us while we're eating?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course.
Hehe. It'll be a lovely way to remember this moment by.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think so too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now then... Shall we start?

rows.Speaker: Saki, Kohane & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
